pins.title: Talented Female Artist Works on Abstract Oil Painting, Using Paint Brush She Cre Video Modern
pins.description: Talented Female Artist Works on Abstract Oil Painting, Using Paint Brush She Creates Modern Masterpiece. Dark and Messy Creative Studio where Large Canvas Stands on Easel Illuminated. Zoom out

Friends, this is one of my works painted in Southern Italy, in the small sunny town of Giovinazzo. That day it was my second painting. I started working on it in the evening, after the sun had gone below the horizon. A rocky shore, silence, and fading light — I wanted to capture that exact moment.

I’m curious if any of you have been to Giovinazzo or to the Apulia region. Share your impressions in the comments — I’d really love to read them, and I’ll definitely reply.
